messages:
sam: Hey team — super last-minute. Flight diverted, stuck at airport. I'm the primary for the 00:00-08:00 PST window tonight and won't be online for the first 4 hours. Pager already fired earlier (incident bot pinged me). Can someone cover primary? I can stay reachable by DM but won't be able to page into a bridge. Sorry for the short notice.

oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] 1754320900 - 5xx spike detected on /v1/email/generate (5.8% error rate over 5m). Pager sent to primary: sam. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/email-5xx 

sam: For context — this impacts transactional sends for MailMate and a couple smaller tenants. Customer impact: delayed sends + 10-15% drop in deliveries if retries don't catch.

lina: I can try to take primary but heads up — I have a call at 01:30 PST (30m). I can cover 00:00-01:45, then need someone else to pick up.
matt: I can flip to primary at 01:45 PST until 08:00. @lina can you hand off to me on the bridge? I'll be at my laptop.
yara: I can be secondary for the whole block. I'll monitor queues and do triage if pager escalates.

sam: @matt awesome, @lina thanks. Matt — please accept primary on PagerDuty and post once accepted. I'm adding the runbook link below.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: matt accepted escalation for rotation slot 00:00-08:00 PST.
matt: Accepted — on it. Can someone confirm current deploys? Last deploy was 23:40 PST to email-worker-prod (small hotfix). If that rollout overlapped, might be related.
deploy-bot: Deploy noticed: email-worker-prod v3.2.7 -> v3.2.8 at 23:40 PST across 4 nodes. No automatic rollback. Health checks passed initially.
alex: I saw increased OOMs on worker-3 around 23:46 in k8s logs, looked like memory spike during large batch send.
yara: I'm tailing logs now. Here's a quick check command:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/email-worker-prod -c worker --since=20m | grep ERROR | tail -n 200
```
I'll paste notable errors to thread.

ops-bot: I've temporarily bumped worker replicas from 4 -> 6 to absorb load. Autoscaler still disabled for this job per the dedicated config.
lina: On bridge now — joining https://zoom.redwood/bridge/ops. Handing off to @matt in 5.
matt: On bridge and have accepted PD. Quick triage plan: 1) verify if 3.2.8 increased memory usage; 2) if yes, rollback to 3.2.7 for email-worker-prod; 3) if rollback not immediate, keep scaling replicas and enable circuit-breaker to reject large batch requests (per runbook).
sam: Matt — if you roll back, use the emergency rollback command in runbook (it's scripted). If rollback is needed, ping infra and I'll approve remotely.

oncall-bot: Runbook excerpt: "If email 5xx spike and recent deploy < 60m, rollback with `deploy rollback email-worker-prod --to v3.2.7 --force` then monitor error rate for 5m."
yara: Error snippet from worker-3: "java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space at com.redwood.email.BatchProcessor.process(BatchProcessor.java:342)" repeated ~150 times between 23:45-23:50.
matt: That strongly points to the last deploy. @ops-bot can you queue a rollback? If ops-bot can't, I'll run the rollback.

ops-bot: Rollback requires human confirmation. @alex please approve rollback of email-worker-prod to v3.2.7.
alex: Approving rollback — go ahead.
matt: Rolling back now.`deploy rollback email-worker-prod --to v3.2.7 --force`

deploy-bot: Rollback started by matt for email-worker-prod -> v3.2.7. Expect 90s per pod.
yara: Watching logs — error rate decreasing. 5xx is down to 1.2% after the first pod came back.
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] 1754322300 - Error rate dropped below threshold (1.1%). Pager auto-notify paused.
lina: Thanks everyone — @sam hope your trip clears. Matt — can you post a short handoff summary when you take full ownership of tonight's primary? Include key actions taken and any follow-ups.
matt: Will do. Quick notes: accepted PD, rolled back email-worker-prod to v3.2.7 (rollback approved by alex), scaled replicas temporarily, monitored logs until 5xx < 1.5%. Primary action: rollback. Follow-ups: schedule postmortem to investigate how v3.2.8 passed initial health checks but caused heap growth; add pre-rollout heap profiling; consider enabling canary traffic for large batches.
sam: I added a calendar note for a postmortem 48h out and invited infra + release lead.
yara: I'll open the incident ticket with logs and the OOM stack trace, link to deploy diff: https://git.redwood/repos/deploys/email-worker-prod/compare/v3.2.7...v3.2.8

oncall-bot: Reminder: primary/secondary rota updated — matt primary, yara secondary for 00:00-08:00 PST.

matt: Posting final handoff summary here for tonight: 1) Incident triggered by 5xx spike; 2) Cause: memory regression in v3.2.8 causing OOMs in batch processing; 3) Mitigation: rolled back to v3.2.7, scaled replicas; 4) Customer impact: MailMate saw delayed sends; no data loss reported; 5) Follow-ups: postmortem scheduled, add canary for batch workloads, add heap prof to CI. I'll stay on the bridge until 00:30 PST to ensure stability then hand over cleanly.
lina: Thanks matt — passing shadow to @yara after 00:30. Good job team :thumbsup:

sam: Appreciate everyone covering. Posting final note: If anyone needs me to reassign anything else, DM.

matt: Locking thread — monitoring continues. If new alerts come in, escalate as usual.

oncall-bot: Thread auto-archived after 4h of inactivity."
